entries.8acca91393b37ce3: This is the cold storage warehouse division. It stores fresh, frozen and processed marine products and similar goods for marine product companies and wholesale market intermediaries. It has a market cold storage warehouse and a Hibino cold storage warehouse in Atsuta Ward, Nagoya. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥538 million.
entries.aff03e8cca0dcc24: A company that wholesales marine products at the Nagoya Central Wholesale Market and also operates cold storage warehouses and real estate leasing.
entries.be931fc814d33610: This is the real estate leasing division. It leases real estate such as apartment buildings. Leased apartment buildings, office buildings, factories, shops and land are located in Nagoya. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥240 million.

entries.d9c6260fec78724b: Wholesale division. As a seafood wholesale business licensed by the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries under the Wholesale Market Act, it receives consignments and makes purchases of fresh, frozen and processed seafood from producers across Japan, and sells them to intermediate wholesalers and others at the Nagoya City Central Wholesale Market by methods such as auction sales. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥36,620 million.
